review_notes: unmarked change: 〜か月 11 = じゅういっかげつ, plain would be じゅういちかげつ

1: * For 10, じゅっ〜 can also be read じっ〜 (e.g. じっぽん).
2: * 1日 is ついたちfor a date (the 1st), but いちにちfor a length of time (one day).
* Days 2–10 use the same readings for lengths of time (e.g. ふつかかん = for two days).
* For April, July and September, do not use よん, なな or きゅう.
3: * 間 (かん) can be added to 分, 日 and 年: いっぷんかん, ふつかかん, いちねんかん.
* 1日 as a length of time is いちにち(as a date it is ついたち).
* か月 is also written ヶ月 or カ月. All are read かげつ.
* Half: 半年 = はんとし, 1時間半 = いちじかんはん.

legend.sound_change: the sound of the number or counter changes
legend.special: special reading, learn it as a word
